lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，啃咬着腐烂的手指。
缓慢移动，发出刺耳尖叫。
嘶嘶作响，四处寻找猎物。

lines.en: Latch onto foes, drag to the deadpile.

lines.zh: 疯狂啃咬，不放过任何一个活物。
嘶吼着，试图撕裂你的皮肉。
lines.en: Scream, trying to tear your flesh.

lines.zh: 逼近玩家，渴望吞噬一切有生命之物。
lines.en: Approach player, yearning to devour all life.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶叫着，寻找新的牺牲品。

lines.en: Dragging a broken leg, I follow the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 一瘸一拐，咬向路边的影子。
lines.en: Limping along, I snap at shadows by the road.

lines.zh: 懒散地晃动，寻找新鲜血液。
漫无目的地走动，寻找目标。
咀嚼着，享受腐烂的味道。
低头嗅探，寻找猎物气味。
凝视远方，似乎在思考什么。
懒懒地站立，等待食物出现。
舔舐嘴唇，想象着血腥场面。
摇晃着脑袋，寻找新的猎物。
蹲在废墟里，等血味飘来。
lines.en: Crouching in the ruins, waiting for the smell of blood.
I count the howls of my kin.
I claw at the rubble with broken nails.
Head tilted, I listen for distant footsteps.
Stare at you, ready to pounce.

lines.zh: 追踪你的身影，伺机而动。
lines.en: Track your shadow, ready to strike.
Fix on you, yearning to devour.

lines.zh: 目不转睛地盯着，寻找机会。

lines.en: A tier-three horde, all for you.
Gaze at player, ready to tear.

lines.zh: 紧盯着你，准备一举击杀。
lines.en: Fix on you, ready to kill.

lines.zh: 目不转睛盯着你，渴望吞噬。

lines.en: Your blood makes me raise my head.
There is a whole crowd behind me.
I see you clearly past the pile of rot.
My eyes won't move; they stay on you.
Your breath is far too fresh.
My throat tightens. I have fixed on you.
Dark blood oozes from the wound.
The horde is still standing; I cannot fall.

lines.zh: 我胸口烂穿了，喘气全是泡声。
lines.en: My chest is rotted through; my breath bubbles.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指伸向你，贪婪的渴望你的血肉。
lines.en: Rotten fingers reach for you, greedy for your flesh.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就要尝尝你的滋味。
lines.en: You move, and I taste your flesh.

lines.zh: 别想跑，尸群很快就会过来。
lines.en: Don't think you can run, the horde is coming.

lines.zh: 靠近我，我的同类们渴望你的能量。
lines.en: Come closer, my brethren hunger for your energy.

lines.zh: 品尝新来的灵魂，非常可口。
lines.en: Taste the new soul, very satisfying.

lines.zh: 你的声音让我想起同类的痛苦。
lines.en: Your voice reminds me of my brethren's pain.

lines.zh: 别担心，你是我们的晚餐。
你身上的血腥味引来了更多。
你身上的血腥味，隔着墙都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the blood on you through the wall.

lines.zh: 挡在我面前，尸群会更愤怒。
lines.en: Block my way, the horde will be angrier.
My horde is not to be trifled with.
You've collided with the horde's fury.

lines.zh: 你们的碰撞激起了我的愤怒。
小心，尸群很快就会到来。
lines.en: Watch out, the horde is coming soon.
You have stumbled into the middle of us.

lines.zh: 我的同类在尸群中寻找伴侣。
lines.en: My kind seek mates in the horde.

lines.zh: 寻找新伙伴，尸群中总有新成员。
lines.en: Seek new partners, there are always new members in the horde.

lines.zh: 尸群中的雌性渴望交配。
lines.en: Females in the horde crave mating.

lines.zh: 与我交配，我的力量会注入你。
lines.en: Mate with me, my strength will enter you.

lines.zh: 我的尸体是交配的对象。
尸群中的交配是求生的方式。
lines.en: Mating in the horde is a way to survive.

lines.zh: 与尸群中的其他生物交配。
lines.en: Mate with other creatures in the horde.

lines.zh: 我的后代将延续尸群的生命。
lines.en: My offspring will continue the horde's life.

lines.zh: 我的尸体是唯一能找到的伴侣。
lines.en: My corpse is the only mate to be found.

lines.zh: 在断墙后找到同行的伴侣。
lines.en: I find a partner behind the broken wall.

lines.zh: 这堆腐肉里有块新鲜的。
lines.en: There is a fresh piece in this rotten pile.
I gnaw a finger bone while I wait for the next meal.

lines.zh: 这堆尸体，正好留给你落脚。
lines.en: This heap of bodies is just the place for you.
Someone is here, the horde follows.

lines.zh: 你的血腥味把我从坟里叫起。
lines.en: Your blood smell called me up from the grave.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的嘶吼已经压不住。
lines.en: The snarl in my throat will not stay down.

lines.zh: 我把它们都叫来了，你等着。
lines.en: I called them all; just wait.

lines.zh: 墙那边有膝盖撞地的声音。
lines.en: A knee hits the ground beyond the wall.

lines.zh: 我叫来的那群，已经围上来了。
lines.en: The horde I called has already closed in.
I smell a living one drawing near.
There is fresh blood in the air.
Legs first, and then you cannot run.
You will be part of me!
I bite your leg first, so you cannot run.
Once bitten, there is no cure.
I will drag you back to the horde to eat slowly.
One more step and you fall.
One bite is enough to make you one of us.

lines.zh: 我一喊，身后就涌上来一整群。
lines.en: One shout from me and the whole pack comes.
Feel my teeth! — 尸群(3), melee attack
I bite your neck and hold on.
My nails dig into your wound.
I tear away skin and flesh.
My teeth crack against your collarbone.
One swipe knocks your head aside.
Blood sprays out, and I grow hungrier.

lines.zh: 他们从四面聚过来，越聚越多。
lines.en: They gather from every side, more and more.
Let them come, the more the better!
There’s too much prey, I can’t eat it all!

lines.zh: 更多的尸体，更多的力量！

lines.en: I crawl out from under the ruins.
One rises from the pile of corpses.
The smell of blood draws us here.
A rotting hand reaches from the brickwork.

lines.zh: 我们一群，从夜里走出来。
lines.en: We come out of the night as a crowd.
The turning begins; one more joins.

lines.zh: 泥水灌进我的肺，浮不起来。
lines.en: Muddy water fills my lungs; I cannot float.

lines.zh: 半边身子被炸飞，我还在爬。
lines.en: Half my body blown away, and I still crawl.

lines.zh: 肚子空得能看见肋骨在动。
lines.en: My belly is so empty you can see the ribs move.
